Facts are proposed by a model identity (or a user) and decided by the named user; the 'fate' field says what happens after confirmation. Recall cases name the reader (tenant a or b, an actor), the facts that must come back (expected) and the facts that must never come back (forbidden). Not an approved business-labeled corpus; no quality threshold is derived from it.
